name: TPF3 Bridge N01 Activation
summary: Development Python/native railway inspection, fitting and explicit construction adapter.
description: Development interface demonstrated on TPF3 build 40408 in a disposable test world. Python publishes data-only request modules; the GameScript performs native inspection, fitting, explicitly requested construction and fresh readback, returning bounded JSON through the game log. Use only an authorised test context. Construction can change the world; no automatic rollback or mutation replay. This is development transport, not a production compatibility guarantee.
